final_answer: Turbine T-4 failed on 14 March 2025 when a corroded bearing seal allowed seawater into the nacelle, causing a multi-week outage (report.md:37). The pilot delivered 18.7 GWh over 24 months—6% below the 19.9 GWh forecast (report.md:80). Final cost reached EUR 41.25 million against an approved budget of EUR 36.7 million, a 12.4% overrun driven by the T-4 repair campaign (report.md:121). Environmental monitoring found no statistically significant impact on fish migration (p = 0.41) (report.md:196). Lead engineer Dr. Ines Marchetti recommended replacing titanium fastener sets with duplex stainless steel on all remaining nacelles—a change accepted in principle by the steering group (report.md:160). The steering group approved Phase 2 for Q3 2026, contingent on a completed bearing seal redesign and a successful dry-dock endurance test (report.md:229).
